info.title: AboutMe Portfolio API
info.description:
REST API for the personal portfolio: RAG chat (`POST /ask`), auth (`POST /auth/login`), Vector store health (`GET /health/chroma` alias, `GET /health/vectorstore`), and admin document tools under `/admin/tools/documents` (HTTP Basic, ADMIN role).

Local SPA (Vite) calls these routes with an `/api` prefix via proxy, e.g. `http://localhost:5173/api/ask` maps to `POST /ask` on the backend at port 8080.
